value.rationale: The reference uses a genuine design freedom in temporal weighting of fast-mode coupling, while its sufficient CFL restrictions give no exact frontier or comparison of weights. The theorem detects a sharp coupling-neutral weight, opposite stabilizing effects on its two sides, and a diverging contrast gain close to rank-one positive stiffness. These affect admissible numerical time steps and are not merely a numerical check or trivial scalar recasting. The accuracy-versus-stability limitation is explicit.
